From: Bramble Notes <security@bramblenotes.example>
Subject: New sign-in to your account

We noticed a new sign-in from Firefox on Windows near Lisbon. If this was you, no action is needed. If not, change your password from your account settings at https://bramblenotes.example/settings/security.

How to reset your password in Quillpad

1. Open the sign-in page and choose 'Forgot password'.
2. Enter your email address.
3. We'll send a link that expires after 30 minutes.
4. Choose a new password of at least 12 characters.

Meeting notes — IT working group

- Agreed to move the team to a password manager by November.
- Minimum password length goes to 14; no forced rotation.
- Priya to draft the reset-flow FAQ for the help desk.
